    VIDEO PRIVACY

    Complete video privacy control

    Vimeo’s privacy controls put you in complete command of who sees your content, where, and when. From client reviews to internal comms, Vimeo's privacy controls ensure your videos stay secure and visible only to the right people.

    Start for free

    You're in great company

    Your video privacy shouldn’t be an afterthought

    • Tired of accidental views?

      Other video platforms default to public viewing

    • Stuck with basic controls?

      Other platforms offer generic, one-size-fits-all privacy

    • Worried about AI privacy?

      Other platforms train AI models on your content

    • Dealing with embed chaos?

      Other platforms let anyone embed your videos anywhere

    Customizable video protection and privacy

    Control video access

    Add team members directly to your videos or send them an unlisted link. For added security, lock your videos with a password. You can even specify which websites have permission to embed your videos.

    Set video permissions

    Choose exactly who can watch your video before it's even finished uploading. Share your video only with specific individuals, put it behind a password, or hide it from everyone but you.

    Collaborate with private video review pages

    Private review pages allow for seamless collaboration with clients and teammates. Share files, comment on works-in-progress, and more — all while keeping you in control of who sees what.

    Video privacy controls for peace of mind

    • Granular access controls

      Set exact permissions for teams and individuals

    • Real-time access removal

      Instantly revoke permissions across all devices

    • Video password protection

      Secure videos with custom passwords instantly

    • Domain-level embed restrictions

      Specify which websites can embed your videos

    • No AI training or data harvesting

      Your Vimeo videos will never be used to train AI models

    • Unlisted video sharing

      Share via secure URLs with privacy hash codes

    • Private team workspaces

      Collaborate securely within your business on Enterprise plans

    • Single sign-on (SSO) integration

      Connect with SAML, SCIM, Okta, and Azure on Enterprise plans

    Answers to common video privacy questions

    • Go to the Help Center

    You can set privacy controls when uploading or anytime after by editing your video settings.

    Vimeo offers five privacy levels:

    • Public (all plans): Discoverable by anyone, appears in search engines
    • Unlisted (paid plans): Accessible only via direct URL with privacy hash
    • Password (paid plans): Requires password entry to view
    • Hide from Vimeo (paid plans): Can be embedded but has no Vimeo page
    • Private (all plans): Visible only to you, account admins, and granted team members

    Simply choose your desired privacy level in your video settings. Changes take effect instantly across all devices and platforms.

    Instantly. Permissions update in real-time across all devices and platforms. When you change a video’s privacy settings or remove team member access, the changes are immediate — no waiting periods or delays.

    Yes, Vimeo provides detailed analytics for all privacy levels. You can see viewer statistics, engagement metrics, and access patterns. Enterprise accounts get additional analytics features for internal content sharing.

    Most advanced privacy features require paid plans.

    Free plans include Public and Private settings.

    Paid plans (Starter, Standard, Advanced) include Unlisted, Password protection, Hide from Vimeo, plus embed domain-level privacy controls.

    Enterprise plans add custom permissions, SSO integration (SAML/SCIM), and advanced team management.

    While Vimeo doesn’t offer automatic time-expiring links, you can manually control access duration by:

    • Using Unlisted videos with privacy hash URLs that you can change by updating privacy settings
    • Setting up password-protected videos and changing passwords when access should expire
    • Adding/removing team members from Private videos as needed
    • Using the “Hide from Vimeo” setting to control when embedded videos are accessible

    For more granular time-based controls, Enterprise accounts offer custom permissions that can be managed through your admin dashboard.

    Download protection varies by privacy setting:

    • Private videos: Cannot be embedded anywhere, providing the strongest download protection
    • Password/Unlisted videos: Have basic download prevention, but determined users with technical knowledge may still access content

    For maximum security, use Private settings combined with team member access controls. Enterprise accounts receive additional forensic tracking capabilities to monitor unauthorized access attempts.

    Team collaboration with Private videos works through Vimeo’s team member system:

    • Private videos are visible to the owner, account admins, and any team members granted access to the video or its folder
    • Team member access is not supported on Free, Basic, or Plus plans
    • Paid plans allow you to add team members and control their access to specific videos or folders
    • Enterprise accounts with SSO can authenticate team members automatically for internal sharing

    You can grant access at the individual video level or organize content in folders with team-specific permissions.
